feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: Patchright
entry.summary: Patchright is a modified Playwright driver for Chromium automation, with browser interaction through Playwright-style APIs and separate client packages.

entry.title: Predicate Python SDK
entry.summary: The Predicate Python SDK gives browser agents semantic page snapshots, UI assertions, and run traces so they can verify actions and inspect failures.

entry.title: WebRetriever
entry.summary: WebRetriever supplies a web-agent evaluation runner and a judge that assesses task completion from captured requests, actions and page URLs.

entry.title: UI-Mate
entry.summary: UI-Mate is a desktop GUI agent that uses screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions for tasks across applications. It also supports workflows learned from recorded demonstrations.

entry.title: DSH Vision Toolkit
entry.summary: DSH Vision Toolkit adds screenshot reading, visual grounding, UI reconstruction, and pixel comparison tools to DeepSeek Harness agents.

entry.title: opencli-plugin-goofish
entry.summary: An OpenCLI adapter for Goofish that exposes shopping, account, listing, and messaging actions through commands backed by a signed-in Chrome session.

entry.title: qianhuiwu/GUI-Actor-7B-Qwen2.5-VL-LiteTrain
entry.summary: A GUI-grounding checkpoint built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with an attention-based action head. Its example predicts a click point from a screenshot and instruction.

entry.title: THUDM/cogagent-chat-hf
entry.summary: A CogAgent chat checkpoint for interpreting GUI screenshots and proposing plans, next actions, and coordinates. The card describes use with web, desktop, and mobile interfaces.

entry.title: webclaw3
entry.summary: A browser-agent skill that uses a local Chrome session to explore tasks, then generates reusable scripts for repeating successful browser workflows.

entry.title: WenyiWU0111/CoMEM-agent-memory-trajectories
entry.summary: A dataset for GUI-agent memory research containing expanded web links, synthesized tasks, and executed trajectories with successful and failed outcomes.

entry.title: Operit AI
entry.summary: An Android agent platform that operates app interfaces and web pages using visual screen understanding, device controls, and browser actions.

entry.title: Screen2AX-Element
entry.summary: A dataset of macOS application screenshots with UI element boxes and category labels for training and evaluating interface element detectors.

entry.title: ScreenVLM
entry.summary: A model that converts web page screenshots into structured markup containing UI element locations, class labels, and visible text.

entry.title: Actell
entry.summary: An iPhone agent prototype observes screenshots or accessibility content and issues taps and drags through CoreDevice, using a VPN loopback or optional hardware relay.

entry.title: AutoGUI-v1-zip
entry.summary: A training data repository for AutoGUI containing an annotated GUI set and selected vision datasets, with instructions for merging their JSON files for fine-tuning.

entry.title: Blender MCP
entry.summary: An MCP server links agents to Blender through a live add-on or saved project files, offering scene execution, runtime Python API lookup and benchmark tools.

entry.title: IOS13-SimulateTouch
entry.summary: An iOS touch-control library supports scripted and remote touch input, records events for playback, and offers image matching and OCR on jailbroken devices.

entry.title: S1-Accurate-LoRA
entry.summary: A LoRA adapter for a desktop agent's decision model uses window screenshots to select an operation and target element from candidate actions when a faster model is uncertain.

entry.title: Spice
entry.summary: A Go SPICE client library receives remote desktop display updates and sends mouse and keyboard events, with interfaces for connection, rendering and clipboard handling.

entry.title: Vision_GUI_Assistant
entry.summary: A GUI-image conversation dataset provides instruction and conversation JSON files for staged visual fine-tuning; its examples ask models to identify interface buttons.

entry.title: AndroidViewClient
entry.summary: A Python Android UI automation tool that creates reusable tests and exposes view-based, gesture and device controls to AI assistants through an MCP server.

entry.title: LGWM data and RSWT-Bench
entry.summary: A dataset of GUI screen transitions for training a world model, released with RSWT-Bench to evaluate whether observed screens follow the intended actions.

entry.title: Mano-CUA-2.0-4B
entry.summary: A released GUI action model that takes a desktop screenshot and task context to produce structured actions, including clicks, typing, scrolling and app launches.

entry.title: autohotkey-mcp
entry.summary: MCP server that lets assistants list, run, stop, and draft AutoHotkey scripts for Windows input automation.

entry.title: handraise-slack
entry.summary: Slack channel adapter for browser-agent handoffs that sends approval requests with page screenshots and returns a person's decision to handraise.

entry.title: Humanoid
entry.summary: Android app exploration component that uses a model learned from human usage traces to rank the input events proposed by DroidBot.

entry.title: WebThinker-R1-32B
entry.summary: Released reasoning checkpoint for web research that searches and navigates pages through interactive clicks while drafting reports from gathered information.

entry.title: cliclick
entry.summary: A macOS command-line utility that performs mouse and keyboard actions. It accepts action commands as arguments or from a file for scripted desktop control.

entry.title: UI2Code_N
entry.summary: A visual language model that turns UI screenshots into code and supports iterative interface editing and polishing. Its card includes a screenshot-to-HTML inference example.

entry.title: WebMCP
entry.summary: A client-side web API proposal that lets pages expose structured JavaScript tools to browser agents. Agents can invoke page functions while sharing the visible interface and context with users.

entry.title: Cella
entry.summary: A control plane for agent sandboxes defined by manifests. It runs workloads on several runtimes and exposes a virtual desktop with screen viewing and input controls.

entry.title: lean-computer-use-mcp
entry.summary: An MCP facade for Windows computer use that condenses accessibility observations, checks state freshness, and records desktop actions for later replay.

entry.title: Claude Chrome Stream
entry.summary: A Chrome automation plugin for computer-use agents that streams browser frames through CDP and links actions to frame IDs. It includes commands and MCP tools.

entry.title: lumos_web_agent_plan_iterative
entry.summary: A fine-tuned Lumos planning-module checkpoint for web-agent tasks, released as model weights alongside a separately listed training dataset.

entry.title: PlayJev
entry.summary: A browser-game agent that selects moves from rendered frames. Its repository provides game environments, a demo, and scripts for training and evaluation.

entry.title: GUI Reflection
entry.summary: GUI Reflection provides agent code that predicts GUI actions from a screen image and task goal, alongside scripts for evaluation and supervised training.

entry.title: macOSWorld
entry.summary: macOSWorld benchmarks GUI agents on tasks across 30 macOS apps in five languages. It supplies a Python testbench for AWS macOS instances and a safety task subset.

entry.title: AgentTab
entry.summary: AgentTab provides task-owned Chrome tabs for AI agents, with page snapshots, browser actions, human handoff, and optional review of consequential actions.

entry.title: asil-qwen35-2b-rl
entry.summary: An ASIL reinforcement-learning checkpoint for an application-control approach based on structured state and semantic actions, released with loadable model weights.

entry.title: asil-qwen35-9b-sft
entry.summary: An ASIL supervised fine-tuning checkpoint for an application-control approach based on structured state and semantic actions, released with loadable model weights.

entry.title: cogagent-vqa-hf
entry.summary: A CogAgent checkpoint oriented toward single-turn visual dialogue; its card also describes GUI screenshot understanding, coordinate actions, and reported GUI dataset results.

entry.title: GUI-DR
entry.summary: GUI-DR generates perturbed web screenshots and interaction trajectories from Mind2Web archives to support GUI grounding evaluation and fine-tuning.

entry.title: Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking
entry.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking, the 2B reasoning edition of the Qwen3-VL vision-language weights, whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile GUIs, including element recognition and tool use.

entry.title: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct
entry.summary: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, the 32B instruction-tuned edition of the Qwen3-VL vision-language weights, whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile GUIs, including element recognition and tool use.

entry.title: AndroidGen-Llama-3-70B
entry.summary: AndroidGen-Llama-3-70B is a released model for agents that carry out tasks across Android applications such as messaging, email and settings without manually labeled interaction data.

entry.title: flutter-skill
entry.summary: An MCP server and CLI that give AI agents screen inspection and interaction tools for running web, desktop and mobile apps. It supports navigation, taps, typing and test assertions.

entry.title: GLM-4.5V
entry.summary: A released vision-language model that documents screen reading, icon recognition, visual-element grounding and desktop operation assistance among its supported tasks.

entry.title: GUI-Actor-3B-Qwen2.5-VL-LiteTrain
entry.summary: A GUI-grounding checkpoint built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B with an attention-based action head. Given a screenshot and instruction, it predicts a click location.

entry.title: OpenAgentSafety
entry.summary: A benchmark for agent safety in multi-step simulations involving browser, filesystem, terminal and messaging tools. It tests responses to ambiguous, conflicting and adversarial instructions.

entry.title: Preflight Bench
entry.summary: A dataset of paired screenshots, click outcomes and checker answers for evaluating pre-click checks on changing web pages. It includes Lance tables and development and test splits.

entry.title: VK DeviceHub
entry.summary: A device-management system for viewing and controlling Android and iOS devices through a browser. It provides remote input, device inventory and a REST API.

entry.title: webmcpify
entry.summary: An agent skill that adds WebMCP tools to existing web apps. It inventories app functions, asks for approval of a tool manifest and checks tool effects in Chrome.

entry.title: Cie1/MMSearch-Plus
entry.summary: A dataset of 311 image-based tasks for evaluating multimodal browsing agents that use iterative image and text retrieval to answer questions.

entry.title: dsh-computer-use-windows
entry.summary: A Windows computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness that observes UI Automation controls and supports window actions, with optional screenshot-based visual recognition.

entry.title: EverFern Navis Extension
entry.summary: A browser extension that connects Navis to a user's regular browser profile through EverFern Desktop, with builds for Chromium browsers and Firefox.

entry.title: Floorp MCP Server
entry.summary: An MCP server that lets AI assistants read pages and operate the Floorp browser through tab controls, navigation, clicks, and form filling.

entry.title: OS-Copilot/OS-Shepherd-100K
entry.summary: A dataset of GUI agent trajectories and screenshots for training models to judge task completion, with supervised records and reinforcement learning splits.

entry.title: gui_and_terminal_operation_recording
entry.summary: A dataset of GUI and terminal operation recordings. GUI sessions include timestamped screenshots, mouse events and keyboard events; terminal sessions include input and output logs.

entry.title: InternVL3-38B
entry.summary: A released InternVL3-38B multimodal checkpoint from a model family whose card documents GUI-operation training samples and GUI-grounding evaluation.

entry.title: linux-use-recipes
entry.summary: A collection of recipes for automating Linux desktop applications and websites with linux-use. It covers browser setup, accessibility pitfalls, posting workflows and verification.

entry.title: Qwen3.5-4B-Browser-Agent-SFT-FP8
entry.summary: An FP8 Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint fine-tuned on browser-agent trajectories with structured actions. Its card provides vLLM serving settings and reports BrowseWebApp-Bench v2 results.

entry.title: Claude-Surf
entry.summary: A Claude Code plugin that connects to VibeSurf to control browser pages, run web automation workflows and access browser-use agents.

entry.title: InternVL3-9B
entry.summary: A released multimodal checkpoint whose training includes GUI operations and whose card documents GUI grounding alongside broader visual and language tasks.

entry.title: Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking
entry.summary: A vision-language checkpoint whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile interfaces, including element recognition and tool use.

entry.title: Scrapeless Scraping Browser
entry.summary: A managed Chromium browser reached through WebSocket and controlled with Puppeteer or Playwright, with configurable sessions, fingerprints and network egress.

entry.title: SikuliX1
entry.summary: An archived desktop automation codebase that locates on-screen elements through image recognition and controls them with simulated mouse and keyboard input.

entry.title: AndroidGen-GLM-4-9B
entry.summary: AndroidGen-GLM-4-9B is a released model for agents that carry out tasks across Android apps without manually labeled interaction data.

entry.title: openadapt-types
entry.summary: openadapt-types supplies validated Python models and JSON schemas for computer-use screens, actions, results, and interaction trajectories.

entry.title: PersonalAlign
entry.summary: PersonalAlign releases AndroidIntent evaluations of personalized mobile GUI agents and HIM-Agent memory for using long-term interaction records.

entry.title: uiautomator2
entry.summary: uiautomator2 is a Python library for controlling Android devices through a device-side UiAutomator service, including app launch and UI element actions.

entry.title: Vadgr
entry.summary: Vadgr runs agent tasks on a desktop computer through a CLI or phone app, using screenshots and input controls for optional app automation.

entry.title: AutoGUI-Qwen-v0.1
entry.summary: A UI vision-language model checkpoint trained on AutoGUI-625k data and fine-tuned from Qwen-VL-Chat for interpreting interfaces.

entry.title: Game AI - Dome Keeper
entry.summary: A game-playing agent for Dome Keeper that combines computer vision and a language model. Its active mod is written in TypeScript and converted to GDScript.

entry.title: InternVL3_5-241B-A28B
entry.summary: A released InternVL3.5 multimodal checkpoint from a family whose card describes GUI interaction, Cascade RL training and adaptive visual resolution.

entry.title: SilbercueSwift
entry.summary: An MCP server for iOS development that gives agents simulator screenshots, UI element inspection, navigation actions and structured test results.

entry.title: GTA1: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent
entry.summary: GTA1 is a GUI agent that samples action proposals, uses a judge to select one, and maps it to a visual target with a reinforcement-trained grounding model.

entry.title: agent-view
entry.summary: A CLI for agents to inspect and operate Electron, Windows Tauri, and Chromium apps through Chrome DevTools Protocol, with accessibility, screenshot, input, and diagnostic commands.

entry.title: AIHawk
entry.summary: AIHawk searches and scores jobs against a resume, then uses Firefox to fill and submit applications selected by the user. It retains each page's response and a screenshot.

entry.title: lumos_unified_ground_iterative
entry.summary: A JSONL training dataset for the Lumos-I grounding module, combining math, question-answering, and web-agent annotations, including examples from Mind2Web.

entry.title: BlenderWorld
entry.summary: A benchmark for agents creating editable Blender projects from text and visual references. It supplies 223 tasks, submission packaging, and an evaluator for scene and visual criteria.

entry.title: InternVL3_5-38B-HF
entry.summary: An HF-format 38B checkpoint in the InternVL3.5 multimodal model family, whose card lists GUI interaction among its capabilities and describes staged training and inference.

entry.title: Qwen3-8B-FormFactory-SFT-LoRA
entry.summary: A Qwen3-8B LoRA adapter fine-tuned on 992 demonstrations for filling web forms in FormFactory, released with instructions for loading it through PEFT.

entry.title: SCOPE-SFT-9B
entry.summary: A Qwen3.5-9B computer-use checkpoint trained on desktop task demonstrations and safety response trajectories, with reported task and attack-avoidance evaluations.

entry.title: Windows MCP Server
entry.summary: An MCP server and CLI that let AI agents inspect Windows application controls and perform desktop actions, with screenshots, mouse, and keyboard available for visual tasks.

entry.title: yolov11l-ui-elements-detection
entry.summary: A YOLO11 fine-tune that locates five kinds of interface elements in macOS application screenshots to support accessibility metadata generation.

entry.title: Awesome Computer Use Ecosystem
entry.summary: A curated reading list of computer-use tools for desktop and browser agents, organized by product ecosystem and capability, with a separate project catalog.

entry.title: Claude Blender
entry.summary: An MCP server and Blender add-on that let an AI assistant control scenes through tools, inspect screenshots and renders, and revise work using visual feedback.

entry.title: kev-0.6b-browser-use-ONNX
entry.summary: A WebGPU-compatible ONNX browser-use model that selects a page element and operation from a goal and candidate elements, with a 4-bit export for JavaScript use.

entry.title: Tango
entry.summary: A TypeScript Android Debug Bridge client that runs in Chromium-based browsers, Node.js, and Electron to provide access to Android devices.

entry.title: easyAppStore
entry.summary: easyAppStore is an agent skill for preparing an iOS release and completing App Store Connect submission steps through a signed-in Chromium browser.

entry.title: Game AI - Balatro
entry.summary: Game AI - Balatro combines detection of cards and interface controls with code for automating play in the Balatro desktop game.

entry.title: Hronaut for Claude Code
entry.summary: Hronaut for Claude Code is a plugin that supplies a coding agent with an MCP server and skill for using a visible browser in a separate project workspace.

entry.title: kev-0.6b-browser-use
entry.summary: kev-0.6b-browser-use is a 0.6B browser decision model that scores candidate page elements and chooses a click, type, or select operation from a task goal.

entry.title: OpenJev-Data
entry.summary: OpenJev-Data provides labeled browser steps for training models to choose a web agent's next operation and target element, plus a fixed test set for endpoint evaluation.

entry.title: Programming with Pixels (PwP)
entry.summary: Programming with Pixels provides a framework and benchmark for software-engineering agents that work in IDEs through screenshots, typing, and clicks.

entry.title: rebrowser-patches
entry.summary: rebrowser-patches modifies Puppeteer and Playwright to reduce browser automation signals, and provides drop-in packages for both libraries.

entry.title: James4Ever0/the_frozen_forest
entry.summary: A dataset archive of screen recordings paired with keyboard and mouse events. Timestamp files align video frames with recorded input actions.

entry.title: ydotool
entry.summary: ydotool is a Linux command-line utility for sending mouse and keyboard input. It provides commands to click, move the pointer, type text and press keys.

entry.title: aside-telegram-bridge
entry.summary: A Telegram bridge and phone Mini App for sending tasks to the Aside browser agent, viewing live progress and transcripts, and responding to its decisions.

entry.title: Google Developer Codelab: Automated UI Testing with Antigravity (Agy) CLI, BrowserMCP, Playwright, and the Browser Agent
entry.summary: A hands-on codelab for creating browser-based UI tests with Antigravity CLI, BrowserMCP and a Playwright agent skill, using an included demo application.
